subject: Pilot Activation: Trellis Health technical commitments & SDK routing
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Lucas Mayer <lucas.mayer@trellishealth.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 14 Jul 2025 15:02:00 +0000
Subject: Pilot Activation: Trellis Health technical commitments & SDK routing

Hi Lucas — thanks again for the demo earlier today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we have a clear on-ramp for the pilot. I’ve attached a draft Mutual Action Plan (Mutual_Action_Plan_Trellis_v1.xlsx).

Summary / success criteria (please confirm):
- Accuracy: intent classification >= 88% on Trellis test set (we'll agree on a 5000-sample evaluation set).
- Latency: P95 generation < 400ms for typical 512-token prompts at 8 concurrent QPS.
- Stability: no more than 1% 5xx errors during a 24h soak at expected load.
- Security: logs retained per your policy; we will supply audit log hooks for Private deployment if required.

Technical commitments we propose:
- Redwood provides streaming SDK + REST routes for the pilot; suggested routes: /v1/generate (batch), /v1/stream (server-sent events) and /v1/embeddings for vector workflows.
- Sidecar pattern for tool calling (webhook forwarding) — we will ship a reference tool-caller module in the SDK for deterministic invocation.
- Prefix KV caching enabled for repeated contexts; we’ll show expected unit token savings in the first week.

Owner assignments (preliminary):
- Marissa: pilot success criteria, stakeholder alignment, weekly checkpoints.
- Ben: SDK integration owner, sample client, and API routing.
- Neha: security/compliance touchpoint and questionnaire owner.

Requested from Trellis before kickoff:
1) A representative anonymized sample dataset (CSV or JSON schema) by EOD Wednesday (we included trellis_sample_schema.csv as an example format).
2) Target peak QPS and a simple traffic profile (expected bursts, session lengths).
3) Any hard constraints on data residency / network egress.

Proposed timeline:
- 7/16: exchange sample data + finalize mutual action plan.
- 7/21–7/24: internal SDK integration spike (Ben + Trellis eng).
- 7/28: pilot kickoff call (technical: streaming, auth, routing).
- 8/04: 48–72h soak with monitoring and handover of acceptance report.

Please reply with any edits to success criteria or ownership. Happy to hop on a short call to finalize.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com
+1 415-555-0199

Attachments: Mutual_Action_Plan_Trellis_v1.xlsx

From: Lucas Mayer <lucas.mayer@trellishealth.com>

Cc: Trellis Health Security Team <security@trellishealth.com>
Date: Tue, 15 Jul 2025 09:18:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Pilot Activation: Trellis Health technical commitments & SDK routing

Thanks Marissa — this is great and aligns with what we discussed. A couple quick clarifications from our side: 

1) Streaming vs batch: our primary path for the pilot is streaming for conversational flows, but we may also evaluate batch generation for nightly processing. Will the SDK support both patterns with the same auth flow?

2) Data residency: our compliance team prefers that PHI-derived features stay within us-east-1. If Redwood routes to another region for capacity, we need an explicit fallback policy.

3) Sample dataset: we will provide an anonymized 5k-row sample by EOD Wednesday. We will also attach a short schema doc for fields.

Also looped in our security team to start the questionnaire (they’ll reach out to Neha).

Best,
Lucas

Great — I'll take point on the SDK work and the initial integration spike. A few implementation notes and commitments from infra/engineering: 

- SDK auth: we’ll provide an API key flow for the PoC and an optional mTLS snippet if you prefer private connectivity. Same credentials will work for both /v1/generate and /v1/stream routes.
- Streaming: we use SSE for compatibility; we’ll include a sample streaming-config-sample.json that demonstrates reconnect/backoff settings, chunk buffering, and heartbeat intervals.
- Tool calling: our SDK includes a tool-handler interface; for Trellis we recommend the webhook-forwarder pattern (tool calls are posted to your /api/tools endpoint with signed headers). We will provide example middleware.
- Rate limits / burst: for the pilot we’ll open a quota of 12 QPS with 50 QPS burst allowed for short intervals. We’ll instrument token and latency breakdowns at the token-level in Console so you can correlate cost.

Proposed dev tasks and owners (week-of):
- 7/16–7/17: Ben & Trellis eng spike — run example streaming client, confirm connectivity. (Ben)
- 7/18–7/20: SDK integration — embed tool-caller, test sample dataset path. (Trellis eng + Ben)
- 7/21: Deliverable — working sample client and a short runbook (streaming-config-sample.json attached). (Ben)

I’ll also add a small checklist to the Mutual Action Plan: routes, auth, retry/backoff, tool-callback URL, and expected test payloads.

Attaching: streaming-config-sample.json (config stub)

—Ben
Ben Carter

- For the streaming reconnect behavior, what happens to in-flight tool-calls if the connection reconnects with a new session id? Are those retried or de-duplicated?

We’re available for the kickoff on 7/28 AM ET. We’ll attach the anonymized sample dataset in a separate email (file: trellis_sample_schema.csv).
